**[P2] Preserve earlier invocation boundaries in terminal roots**

This end time comes only from the terminal invocation's fresh clock anchor. If wall time moves backward between resumes, `Workflow` and `DurableExecutionRoot` can end before spans exported by an earlier invocation; the new negative-wall-step test explicitly omits that containment assertion. Retain a per-execution high-water mark across `resetInvocationState()` and clamp terminal root completion to it in both plugins, with a rollback regression assertion.
